description: Ticketmaster Discovery API — search attractions (artists, sports teams, performers) by keyword, classificationName, or other filters. Returns attraction name, ID, classifications, and images.

keyword.description: Artist, team or performer name, e.g. "Taylor Swift". Omitting it returns Ticketmaster's default attraction feed, not a search.

page.description: 0-based page number. Deep paging is capped at page × size ≤ 1000.

sort.description: Sort order. Ticketmaster accepts only these values for attractions; anything else is a 400.

name: attraction_search

outputSchema.description: Raw JSON response from Ticketmaster attraction search API

title: Attraction Search
